title: Higher Education and Career Planning
summary: Post-school options (universities, universities of technology, TVET colleges, learnerships, work), admission requirements and the APS, funding, application timelines, and trends in the world of work.

notes.title: Worked example: calculating an APS
notes.problem: A learner's marks for six subjects (excluding LO): English 72%, Maths 65%, Physical Sciences 58%, Life Sciences 74%, Geography 61%, isiZulu 81%. Calculate her APS.

notes.label: Apply early
notes.text: Applications for most universities open in **Grade 12, around April to September**, and close earlier for popular courses (e.g. medicine). Use **Grade 11 final results** to apply. Apply to several institutions and courses.

items: **NSFAS** (National Student Financial Aid Scheme) for students from low-income households at public universities and TVET colleges.
Bursaries from companies, government departments and SETAs.
Technology and automation are changing many jobs; digital skills are increasingly important.
**Scarce skills** in South Africa include engineering, artisans, ICT, health professions and teaching (Maths and Science).
Many people now work in the **gig economy** (short-term or freelance work) and need entrepreneurship skills.
**Soft skills** (communication, teamwork, problem-solving, adaptability) are valued by all employers.

questions.prompt: Name THREE ways to fund post-school studies.

questions.prompt: Name THREE soft skills employers value and explain why one of them is important.
questions.memo:
✓✓ Two or three soft skills, e.g. communication, teamwork, problem-solving, adaptability (2)
✓ Explanation of why one matters (1)

questions.prompt: Why should learners apply to more than one institution?
questions.memo:
✓ Places are limited and competitive (1)
✓ so applying widely increases the chance of being accepted somewhere (1)

questions.prompt: How might automation affect future careers? Give ONE threat and ONE opportunity.
questions.memo:
✓ Threat: routine jobs may be replaced by machines (1)
✓ Opportunity: new jobs in technology, maintenance, data and design (1)
